page: Google Cloud Platform h4d-highmem-192-lssd is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the h4d server family. It features 192 dedicated vCPUs and 1488.0 GB of RAM, yielding a resource density of 7.75 GB of memory per core. The server configuration includes 10 local SSDs as part of its basic specification, though explicit local storage capacity metrics are not defined. It does not include any GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

This server is designed for memory-intensive workloads that require substantial CPU resources. The high memory-to-vCPU ratio makes it suitable for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning systems, and intensive data processing tasks. The presence of dedicated vCPUs ensures consistent compute performance without resource sharing.
